backend.name: Engine backend
backend.hint: Automatic uses the compiled (WASM) engine when it loads, falling back to JavaScript. Both produce identical geometry — verified against the same fixture corpus — so this only affects speed. Compiled is ~12x faster on large scenes.

run.name: Wall autocomplete: run
run.hint: Complete the walls on the current scene. Reversible — undo removes exactly this run.

undo.name: Wall autocomplete: undo last run
undo.hint: Remove the walls the last run created and restore any it trimmed. Press again to peel back the run before it.

preview.name: Wall autocomplete: preview
preview.hint: Report what would be built without writing anything.

notify.backendUnavailable: Wall autocomplete: backend "{want}" unavailable, using JavaScript.
notify.nothingToUndo: Wall autocomplete: nothing of mine on this scene to undo.
